extra_snippets: We listened closely, fixed sharp edges, hardened the platform, and iterated until Flux started to feel like the tool we always wanted to use. This funding lets us move faster on the parts of Flux that matter most for serious work.

We were also excited about what AI could unlock for hardware as early as 2019, back when that was not the obvious bet.
